description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperience entity class for the OrangeHRM application using Doctrine ORM. It models an employee's work experience with properties such as employer, job title, dates, comments, and a relation to the Employee entity. It includes getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperience
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's work experience with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the starting date of employment.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of employment.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the ending date of employment.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of employment.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments related to the work experience.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the work experience.

methods.name: getInternal
methods.description: Retrieves the deprecated internal field value.

methods.name: setInternal
methods.description: Sets the deprecated internal field value.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this work experience.
